message:
docs(policy): the verifying Claude does not delegate a plan it wants changed before Codex confirms the change

Adds the sentence Codex asked for to the verifier's role in AGENTS.md and CLAUDE.md: a part
of a plan the verifier judges to need changes is not delegated to the working Claude until
Codex has revised and confirmed it; an independent scope approved without changes may be
delegated at once. Prevents the verifier from pre-delegating its own amendments.
history #408 addendum.
